description: This file defines a React-like component called 'NoteMain' using the Qwik framework. It manages displaying, editing, and handling user interactions for a note object, including saving, deleting, and canceling edits. The component also handles loading states and conditional rendering based on whether a note is being edited or viewed.

methods.name: NoteMain
methods.description: A Qwik component that renders a note with functionalities to view, edit, save, cancel, and delete the note. It manages local form state and responds to prop changes.
